subtitle: Your Reliable Partner in Food Manufacturing & Ingredient Distribution
storyText:
Fruitica d.o.o. began its journey in 1996 as a food ingredients trading company. Through years of market experience and close cooperation with international suppliers, we build a strong distribution network in Serbia and surrounding markets.

In 2012, we expanded into a manufacturing by launching our instant powdered beverage production in Čantavir, near Subotica, strategically located close to the E75 highway.

Today, we operate as an integrated food solutions company, combining sourcing expertise with industrial production.
missionText: To deliver reliable, high-quality food solutions - whether through finished beverage products or functional raw materials - while building long-term partnerships based on trust and performance.
visionText: To become a recognized leader in both instant beverage manufacturing and professional ingredient distribution.

quality_policy_para1: Only satisfied customers return to purchase again - and through regular purchases of our products they ensure the long-term sustainability of Fruitica d.o.o., thereby providing a stable foundation for the livelihood of all employees in the company.
quality_policy_para2: Therefore, meeting not only the stated requirements but also the unstated expectations of customers, i.e., ensuring product quality and safety, is a priority obligation of employees at all levels of activity within Fruitica d.o.o.
quality_policy_para3: The achievement of the above objectives is accomplished through the implementation of a Quality and Product Safety Management System in accordance with the requirements of ISO 9001, IFS Food, and the HACCP system, which includes:
quality_policy_list_item1: Compliance with all relevant regulations related to the company's operations
quality_policy_list_item2: The commitment of management to define business objectives that support this policy and to ensure an internal environment in which employees can fully participate in achieving the company's goals
quality_policy_list_item3: Involvement of all employees in achieving company objectives
quality_policy_list_item4: Continuous efforts to identify and meet customer requirements and expectations in order to ensure their satisfaction
quality_policy_list_item5: Understanding and managing activities as processes
quality_policy_list_item6: Understanding, recognizing, and utilizing the interrelationships between different processes, i.e., applying a systematic approach for more efficient and effective achievement of objectives
quality_policy_list_item7: Conscious and continuous improvement of product safety and quality, as well as the overall performance of the organization
quality_policy_list_item8: Understanding and ensuring product health safety, quality, legality, and authenticity
quality_policy_list_item10: Building mutually beneficial, partnership-based relationships with suppliers
